task.selected_finding: H-01: Silent inactive reward handling permanently consumes validator claims without payment

disclosures: The outer consensus-claim processor that consumes a successful claim is in the separately audited recallnet/ipc repository and is not agent-visible in this Solidity candidate; the report supplies that cross-repository system context.
Two historical recallnet/ipc submodules use inaccessible SSH-only hokunet remotes, so the IPC task group was not materialized and is not represented as reproducible.
The ValidatorGater component of RECL-05 is excluded from H-01 because the report does not establish a concrete asset-loss path for that component.

The unmodified full upstream suite is 76/79 under Foundry 1.3.6: two LibWasm revert-depth expectations and one legacy testFail name are toolchain compatibility failures. The selected Rewarder suite is 20/20 and the compatible Gater subset is 7/7.
The review image is local-only and has no registry digest; admission must rebuild and digest-pin an approved image from the exact approved candidate.
